findings.statement: Rank 1 in convergence (score 4.5197). Open Targets association score 0.3088, rank 79 of 1998. Cell membrane and microvillus membrane protein (UniProt Q16790), so accessible to antibodies. Drugs: GIRENTUXIMAB (PHASE_3), IODINE I 124 GIRENTUXIMAB (PHASE_2), SULTHIAME (PHASE_4), ETHOXZOLAMIDE (WITHDRAWAL). TCGA log2FC 9.712 (padj 2.58e-30), protein log2FC 2.269. DepMap: mean ccRCC effect 0.051, 0 of 24 lines dependent, not selective, so this is an antibody/imaging/biomarker case and not a dependency case. Mutation recurrence is negligible (1 of 511 patients).

Rank 3 in convergence (score 4.2143). Plasma membrane ligand of CD27 (UniProt P32970). Drugs: VORSETUZUMAB MAFODOTIN (PHASE_1), VORSETUZUMAB (PHASE_1), MDX-1411 (PHASE_1), CUSATUZUMAB (PHASE_2). TCGA log2FC 7.09 (padj 6.45e-25), protein log2FC 2.421, tumour-intrinsic component 1. DepMap shows no ccRCC dependency (mean effect 0.251, selectivity 0.006), so the case rests on a membrane antigen for ADC, antibody or CAR-T and not on gene essentiality. Open Targets association score is only 0.0572.

Rank 29 in convergence (score 3.2997). Apical cell membrane and secreted ectoenzyme that hydrolyses 2',3'-cGAMP (UniProt O14638). Drug: AGS-16C3F (PHASE_2), an ADC-type agent. TCGA log2FC 5.557 (padj 1.66e-22), protein log2FC 1.544, tumour-intrinsic component 1. DepMap selectivity 0.026, so no dependency. Tractable and tumour-up, with an untested immune-modulation angle.

Established ccRCC drug target (HIF-2 alpha). Rank 38 in convergence (score 3.2355, 6 streams). Open Targets association score 0.4871. Drug: BELZUTIFAN (APPROVAL). Tractability labels include SM: Approved Drug. Pathways include Regulation of gene expression by Hypoxia-inducible Factor. DepMap is the only gene here with ccRCC selectivity: mean effect -0.143 in ccRCC vs 0.157 in other lines, selectivity 0.3, fraction of ccRCC lines dependent 0.208, padj 0.061, not common essential. Mutation recurrence is low (freq 0.004), so this is a pathway-driven dependency and not a mutation-driven one.

Core ccRCC driver. Open Targets association score 0.6466 (top of the disease list). Somatic mutation in 247 of 511 tumours (freq 0.483, padj 0.0, recurrent), with 0.791 CNV loss frequency. Convergence rank 16 (score 3.5434). No drugs are listed for VHL itself. It is a mechanism and stratification marker, and the therapeutic route is downstream HIF-2 alpha. DepMap selectivity is -0.835, consistent with a tumour suppressor and not a dependency.

Rank 7 in convergence (score 3.9643); highest-ranked metabolic gene that is both tumour-up and prognostic. Cytoplasmic methyltransferase that consumes SAM and lowers repressive H3K27me3 (UniProt P40261). TCGA log2FC 4.685 (padj 5.62e-27), protein log2FC 2.709, Cox log HR 0.301 (padj 0.00479), so high expression is adverse. No drugs are listed. DepMap mean effect 0.316 with selectivity -0.075 shows no ccRCC dependency, so this is a stronger biomarker case than a target case. Open Targets score is 0.0598.

Rank 5 in convergence (score 4.1052). Open Targets association score 0.4049, with genetic association component 0.519. TCGA log2FC 3.989 (padj 1.43e-31), protein log2FC 1.837, tumour-intrinsic component 0.941. No drugs are returned in the ranking row. DepMap mean effect 0.002, selectivity -0.021, so no dependency. Tractable but untested in ccRCC.

Rank 2 in convergence (score 4.2206). Down in tumour: TCGA log2FC -4.741 (padj 6.57e-11), protein log2FC -2.273. Low expression is associated with worse prognosis (Cox log HR -0.358, padj 0.000023). No drugs are listed. Open Targets score is 0.0701. Biomarker (loss of proximal tubule identity), not a target.

Rank 4 in convergence (score 4.1667). Down in tumour: TCGA log2FC -6.154 (padj 5.42e-13), protein log2FC -2.264, prognostic (Cox log HR -0.402, padj 0.0000433). Drugs returned: PROBENECID (PHASE_4), PRATOSARTAN (PHASE_3), which are transporter substrates or inhibitors and not tumour-directed. Loss-type marker; DepMap selectivity 0.072, no dependency.

Established ccRCC drug class (mTOR inhibitors). Open Targets association score 0.525, sixth in the disease top-targets list after VHL, PBRM1, KDM5C, BAP1 and SETD2. Not in the top 40 of the convergence ranking, so it is supported by prior clinical and genetic association but not by new omics convergence in this dataset.

caveats: Association-only genes (VHL, PBRM1, KDM5C, BAP1, SETD2) top Open Targets but not necessarily the omics-convergence ranking; PBRM1, KDM5C, BAP1 and SETD2 were not profiled further here and are not in the findings.

DepMap shows no ccRCC-selective dependency for the top convergent genes (CA9, CD70, ENPP3, NNMT, SCARB1); their case is antigen or biomarker based, a weaker target case without dependency. EPAS1 is the only one with selectivity (0.3), and its padj is 0.061.
Several drugs listed for ranked genes (probenecid, furosemide, SGLT2 inhibitors, cinacalcet) are for non-oncology indications and are not ccRCC-directed.
DepMap and mutation_recurrence results for CA9 and CD70 returned evidence_id null, so those figures are cited through the convergence row only.

STRING interactors were not queried; tool budget used on convergence, location, dependency and drug checks. Several top-ranked genes (ALDOB, UMOD, SLC22A8) are down in tumour because ccRCC lacks proximal tubule features, so they mark tissue identity as much as tumour biology.
